title: Scope
description: First-class work container with context tracking (RFC-003, RFC-009). Scopes organize work and own ContextFrames for attention tracking, and are access boundaries (RFC-011): entering requires a grant; items carry scope membership in metadata.scopes. Visibility (RFC-011 visibility addendum) is a read axis: public scopes' items are readable from any frame; private scopes keep frame-gated reads.

label.description: Human-readable name for this scope. Names the entity domain, never the visibility — e.g. 'Personal', not 'Private'.

visibility.description: Read-visibility axis (RFC-011 visibility addendum). public: items labeled with this scope are readable by all principals from any frame. private: items are readable only inside the scope's frame (entry grant-gated). Defaults to private (restricted-by-default, RFC-011 §4.1).

active_participants.description: UUIDs of operator/agents currently active in this scope

artifact_uuids.description: UUIDs of artifacts belonging to this scope (unordered, for enumeration only)
